topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Rain's been coming down hard, and the city's just a blur of headlights and reflections. Got a call from an old acquaintance, someone who's seen the wrong side of this town. Turns out, their kid has the same teacher they had. I can't help but think, what are the odds in this concrete jungle? It's not a small world; it's a tight one, and things always find a way to come full circle. Especially things you don't want to come back around. This teacher, they had a way of getting under your skin, making you wonder what was real and what was just the shadow of something you thought you knew. The kid deserves a fresh start, a clean slate, but I can feel the weight of the past pressing down, heavy and wet like the rain. I promised I'd look into it, but I already know this ain't gonna be a walk in the park.
